execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."ai_executions" (
  "agent" text NOT NULL,
  "approvedBy" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "recommendation" text,
  "request" text NOT NULL,
  "shipmentId" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'RUNNING' NOT NULL,
  "toolCalls" json NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ai_executions_agent_check_8e7cc056" CHECK ("agent" IN ('OPERATIONS_AGENT', 'SUPPORT_AGENT')),
  CONSTRAINT "ai_executions_status_check_f7af5ecd" CHECK ("status" IN ('RUNNING', 'WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."companies" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "plan" text DEFAULT 'TRIAL' NOT NULL,
  "suspended" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "companies_plan_check_16898502" CHECK ("plan" IN ('TRIAL', 'BASIC', 'PRO', 'ENTERPRISE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."location_events" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "longitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "recordedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "workerId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "read" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text,
  "workerId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_type_check_08a83016" CHECK ("type" IN ('SHIPMENT_ASSIGNED', 'DELIVERY_UPDATED', 'NEW_TASK', 'DELIVERY_FAILED', 'AI_RECOMMENDATION', 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."proof_of_delivery" (
  "capturedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "gpsLatitude" float8,
  "gpsLongitude" float8,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "photoUrl" text,
  "shipmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "signatureUrl" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."shipment_history" (
  "event" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "occurredAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "shipmentId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."shipments" (
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "destination" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'NORMAL' NOT NULL,
  "requestedBy" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'CREATED' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "warehouseId" text,
  "workerId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "shipments_priority_check_72dbae57" CHECK ("priority" IN ('LOW', 'NORMAL', 'HIGH', 'URGENT')),
  CONSTRAINT "shipments_status_check_efddab2e" CHECK ("status" IN ('CREATED', 'READY_FOR_DISPATCH', 'ASSIGNED', 'PICKED_UP', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', 'DELIVERED', 'CANCELLED', 'FAILED_DELIVERY', 'RESCHEDULED', 'RETURNED', 'ON_HOLD'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "companyId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "fullName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isEmailVerified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "refreshToken" text,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "verificationToken" text,
  "verificationTokenExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_8e96eaf0" CHECK ("role" IN ('PLATFORM_ADMIN', 'COMPANY_ADMIN', 'MERCHANT', 'ACCOUNTANT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."vehicles" (
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "plateNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "vehicles_type_check_8ef84690" CHECK ("type" IN ('MOTORCYCLE', 'CAR', 'VAN', 'TRUCK'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."warehouses" (
  "address" text NOT NULL,
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."workers" (
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fullName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OFFLINE' NOT NULL,
  "successRate" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "vehicleId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "workers_status_check_ef9962ab" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'OFFLINE', 'ON_BREAK', 'SUSPENDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."zones" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "warehouseId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
